title: Seed bytes correctly zeroized after Ed25519Key construction
description: In both smtp/main.rs and reader/server_stores.rs, the seed Vec is explicitly zeroized with seed.zeroize() immediately after Ed25519Key::from_seed_and_public_key(). This is the correct behavior — the seed is the private key material and must not linger in heap memory. A future contributor might remove this as 'unnecessary cleanup', but it is the security-correct pattern for any key material in heap-allocated memory. Worth defending.
